description: What an amendment to a Japanese law changes, and when; for what changes across every law between two days, list_changes. A law's amendments whose changes japanlaw.org holds: the amending Act (titles, law number), the day it takes effect, whether it is in force, not yet in force or since replaced (state), how many provisions it changes, adds and removes, and its version — the text it leaves, which get_provision and fetch read where textHeld is true. With version — {"law": "labor-standards-act", "version": "20270401_508AC0000000060"} — every provision that amendment changes, its wording before and after in Japanese and English, and whose each English is (beforeEnglishWhose, afterEnglishWhose). A long one stops at a provision; continued.cursor, passed back as cursor with the same version, goes on. An amendment e-Gov publishes no text for is named as such (comparedAcross, textPublished false): its changes are listed with the next amendment's and cannot be told apart from them — never describe them as its own. One whose changes are not held says so; never describe its changes from memory. Link each amendment by its url.

cursor.description: Go on from here: the cursor an earlier answer's continued gave, with the same version.

lang.description: The language of the pages every url opens, and of the card get_provision is drawn as: "en" (default) or "ja". The text returned always holds both languages.

law.description: The law: its Japanese title (労働基準法), English title (Labor Standards Act), short name (労基法), slug (labor-standards-act) or e-Gov law ID (322AC0000000049).

version.description: One amendment, by the version a list gave (20270401_508AC0000000060) — the text it leaves, as get_provision and fetch take it: its changes, provision by provision. Unset lists the amendments.

name: get_amendments
title: See what amendments changed
